title: PriceStat
description: Price statistics for one hospital + procedure code + payer group, derived by the pipeline from public price-transparency files. Numeric fields are nullable because we never invent or interpolate a number we do not have. Every record carries data_source and data_year.

hospital_id.description: id of the hospital in hospitals.json.

code.description: Procedure code. Must exist in procedures.json.

code_system.description: Which coding system `code` belongs to, if known.

payer_group.description: Normalized payer bucket this statistic belongs to.

min_rate.description: Minimum negotiated rate in US dollars, or null if unknown.

median_rate.description: Median negotiated rate in US dollars, or null if unknown. When min/median/max are all present: min_rate <= median_rate <= max_rate.

max_rate.description: Maximum negotiated rate in US dollars, or null if unknown.

cash_price.description: Discounted cash price in US dollars, or null.

gross_charge.description: Gross (chargemaster) charge in US dollars, or null.

data_source.description: Where these figures came from. Required.

data_year.description: Year the figures are from. Required.
